svg.title: Every finite word is positive when 0 < λ < 1; the noiseless model has forbidden events Yt+2 = Yt. Adjacent pairs are uniform for all these models. Each triple slice is My = T λ/9. It has ordinary rank three, so its nonnegative rank is exactly three. The quantum factors Ay i = ρi/9, By j = Eλ j have size two, and PSD rank one would force ordinary rank one. Hence Theorem 2.1 and the classical baseline give the exact comparison
